title: sisymbrium orizabae
intro: Sisymbrium orizabae, commonly known as Mexican gold of ozone or wild heliotrope, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Sisymbrium orizabae include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
